nodes.text: @mancunianmedic During my recent ICU clinical cover, I have seen influenza A, parainfluenza, RSV, COVID & human metapneumovirus all result in acute hypoxaemia requiring ICU admission. Viruses do exist, they are not “just a cold” for some, & there are LOTS of them about. #VaccinesSaveLives
